12: const NAMES = ['pistol', 'shotgun', 'chaingun', 'rocket'];

15: const KICK_SPRING = 300;
16: const KICK_DAMP = 2 * Math.sqrt(KICK_SPRING);

21: const easeOut = (k) => 1 - (1 - k) * (1 - k);

23: export function createWeapons(engine, player, scene, hooks) {
24:   let ammo = { shell: C.WEAPONS.shotgun.ammoStart, bullet: C.WEAPONS.chaingun.ammoStart, rocket: C.WEAPONS.rocket.ammoStart };

43:     grip: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3f2f1e, roughness: 0.85, metalness: 0.0 }),
44:     brass: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xb08a3a, roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.9 }),
45:     accent: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4db8ff, emissive: 0x1a6a99, emissiveIntensity: 0.9, roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.4 }),

48:   function mesh(geo, mat, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, rx = 0, ry = 0, rz = 0) {
49:     const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
50:     m.position.set(x, y, z);
51:     m.rotation.set(rx, ry, rz);

55:   function box(w, h, d, mat, x, y, z, rx = 0, rz = 0) {

80:       g.add(cyl(0.022, 0.022, 0.42, 8, 'dark', 0, -0.045, -0.1));        // magazine

89:       g.userData.tip.set(0, 0.02, -0.42);

97:       g.add(box(0.16, 0.16, 0.42, 'dark', 0, 0, 0.02));                 // corpo
98:       g.add(cyl(0.078, 0.078, 0.14, 10, 'steel', 0, 0, -0.14));         // guarda do cano
99:       g.add(box(0.12, 0.06, 0.1, 'dark', 0, 0.11, 0.06));               // alimentador
100:       g.add(box(0.08, 0.1, 0.12, 'grip', 0, -0.13, 0.2));               // empunhadura
101:       g.add(box(0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 'accent', 0, 0.125, -0.24));          // indicador emissivo
102:       g.userData.barrels = barrels;
103:       g.userData.tip.set(0, 0.02, -0.46);
104:     } else {

106:       g.add(cyl(0.09, 0.09, 0.06, 10, 'steel', 0, 0, -0.36));           // boca alargada
107:       g.add(cyl(0.078, 0.078, 0.03, 10, 'accent', 0, 0, 0.02));         // anel emissivo
108:       g.add(box(0.014, 0.06, 0.02, 'steel', 0.06, 0.075, -0.12));       // mira frontal
109:       g.add(box(0.05, 0.06, 0.014, 'steel', 0, 0.075, 0.06));           // mira traseira
110:       g.add(box(0.06, 0.09, 0.18, 'grip', 0, -0.03, 0.34));             // coronha
111:       g.add(box(0.06, 0.09, 0.1, 'grip', 0, -0.11, 0.2));               // punho
112:       g.add(box(0.05, 0.05, 0.08, 'dark', 0, -0.09, 0.29));             // apoio de ombro

116:     g.position.set(BASE_X, BASE_Y, BASE_Z);

118:   }

120:   const viewmodels = NAMES.map((n) => {
121:     const g = buildViewmodel(n);
122:     g.visible = false;
123:     viewGroup.add(g);
124:     return g;
125:   });
126:   viewmodels[0].visible = true;
127: 
128:   // Muzzle flash: plano aditivo curto + luz pontual que some rápido.
129:   const muzzle = new THREE.Mesh(
130:     new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.16, 0.16),
131:     new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffd873, transparent: true, opacity: 0.95, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide }),
132:   );
133:   muzzle.visible = false;
134:   viewGroup.add(muzzle);
135:   const muzzleLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffb84d, 0, 7);
136:   viewGroup.add(muzzleLight);
137: 
138:   // Partículas: cápsulas (pistol/shotgun/chaingun) e fumaça (rocket).
139:   const casings = [];
140:   const smokes = [];
141:   const smokeMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x9a9a9a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.65 });
142:   function spawnCasing(pos) {
143:     const c = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.02, 0.02, 0.035), materials.brass.clone());
144:     c.material.transparent = true;
145:     c.position.copy(pos);
146:     c.velocity = new THREE.Vector3(0.55 + Math.random() * 0.35, 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.3, -0.2 - Math.random() * 0.2);
147:     c.angVel = new THREE.Vector3(Math.random() * 9, Math.random() * 9, Math.random() * 9);
148:     c.life = 0.9;
149:     viewGroup.add(c);
150:     casings.push(c);
151:   }
152:   function spawnSmoke(pos) {
153:     const s = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.045 + Math.random() * 0.03, 6, 6), smokeMat.clone());
154:     s.position.copy(pos);
155:     s.velocity = new THREE.Vector3((Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.25, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3 - 0.25);
156:     s.grow = 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.5;
157:     s.life = 0.6;
158:     viewGroup.add(s);
159:     smokes.push(s);
160:   }
161: 
162:   const camDir = () => {
163:     const e = new THREE.Euler(camera.rotation.x, camera.rotation.y, 0, 'YXZ');
164:     const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(e);
165:     const v = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1).applyQuaternion(q);
166:     return v;
167:   };
168: 
169:   function hitscanDamage(w, count = 1) {
170:     const dir = camDir();
171:     const origin = { x: camera.position.x, y: camera.position.y, z: camera.position.z };
172:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
173:       const s = spreadOffset(chaingunSpread(w.spread, spin));
174:       const dx = dir.x + dir.x * s.a - dir.z * s.b;
175:       const dz = dir.z + dir.z * s.a + dir.x * s.b;
176:       const wallDist = raycastWall(hooks.map, origin.x, origin.z, dx, dz);
177:       for (const e of hooks.getEnemies()) {
178:         if (e.dead) continue;
179:         const ex = e.x - origin.x, ez = e.z - origin.z;
180:         const t = ex * dx + ez * dz;
181:         const px = origin.x + t * dx - e.x, pz = origin.z + t * dz - e.z;
182:         if (t > 0 && Math.hypot(px, pz) < 0.5 && t < wallDist) {
183:           e.takeDamage(w.damage * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4));
184:           hooks.impact(e.x, e.y + 1, e.z);
185:         }
186:       }
187:     }
188:   }
189: 
190:   function fire() {
191:     const w = C.WEAPONS[NAMES[current]];
192:     if (!canFire(w, ammo)) { hooks.noAmmo(); return; }
193:     if (!fireReady(w, sinceLast)) return;
194:     sinceLast = 0;
195:     ammo = consumeAmmo(w, ammo);
196:     const isRocket = NAMES[current] === 'rocket';
197:     kickV += (w.rate < 0.15 ? 0.12 : 0.5) * Math.sqrt(KICK_SPRING) * (isRocket ? 2.6 : 1.0);
198:     liftV += 0.05;
199:     muzzleT = 0.045;
200:     firingT = NAMES[current] === 'chaingun' ? 0.12 : 0;
201:     if (current === 0) spin = 0;
202:     else spin = Math.min(1, spin + 0.25);
203:     muzzle.rotation.z = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
204:     muzzle.scale.setScalar(0.8 + Math.random() * 0.5);
205:     const vm = viewmodels[current];
206:     const tip = vm.userData.tip;
207:     if (isRocket) {
208:       spawnSmoke(new THREE.Vector3(tip.x, tip.y, tip.z));
209:       spawnSmoke(new THREE.Vector3(tip.x + 0.03, tip.y + 0.02, tip.z - 0.04));
210:     } else {
211:       spawnCasing(new THREE.Vector3(tip.x, tip.y - 0.03, tip.z + 0.09));
212:       if (NAMES[current] === 'pistol') slideBack = 0.035;
213:       if (NAMES[current] === 'shotgun') pumpBack = 0.09;
214:     }
215:     hooks.shoot();
216:     if (isRocket) {
217:       const dir = camDir();
218:       hooks.spawnProjectile({ x: camera.position.x + dir.x * 0.8, y: camera.position.y - 0.1, z: camera.position.z + dir.z * 0.8 }, dir);
219:     } else {
220:       hitscanDamage(w, NAMES[current] === 'shotgun' ? w.pellets : 1);
221:     }
222:   }
223: 
224:   function select(i) {
225:     if (i === current && !switchState) return;
226:     if (switchState) { // interrompe troca em andamento e finaliza o alvo pendente
227:       current = switchState.to;
228:       viewmodels.forEach((gg, k) => { gg.visible = k === current; });
229:       switchState = null;
230:     }
231:     switchState = { phase: 'out', t: 0, from: current, to: i };
232:   }
233: 
234:   function update(dt) {
235:     sinceLast += dt;
236: 
237:     // Muzzle flash (só enquanto disparando).
238:     if (muzzleT > 0) {
239:       muzzleT -= dt;
240:       const tip = viewmodels[current].userData.tip;
241:       muzzle.visible = true;
242:       muzzle.position.set(tip.x, tip.y, tip.z);
243:       muzzle.rotation.z += dt * 4;
244:       muzzleLight.position.set(tip.x, tip.y, tip.z);
245:       muzzleLight.intensity = 9 * Math.max(0, muzzleT / 0.045);
246:     } else {
247:       muzzle.visible = false;
248:       muzzleLight.intensity = 0;
249:     }
250: 
251:     // Recuo: mola criticamente amortecida com retorno suave.
252:     kick += kickV * dt;
253:     kickV += (-kick * KICK_SPRING - kickV * KICK_DAMP) * dt;
254:     lift += liftV * dt;
255:     liftV += (-lift * KICK_SPRING - liftV * KICK_DAMP) * dt;
256:     if (kick <= 0.001) { kick = 0; kickV = Math.max(0, kickV); }
257:     if (lift <= 0.001) { lift = 0; liftV = Math.max(0, liftV); }
258:     firingT = Math.max(0, firingT - dt);
259:     slideBack = Math.max(0, slideBack - dt * 0.22);
260:     pumpBack = Math.max(0, pumpBack - dt * 0.16);
261: 
262:     // Troca de arma: sai baixando/deslizando, entra subindo (~190ms).
263:     if (switchState) {
264:       switchState.t += dt;
265:       if (switchState.phase === 'out' && switchState.t >= SWITCH_OUT) {
266:         current = switchState.to;
267:         viewmodels.forEach((gg, k) => { gg.visible = k === current; });
268:         kickV += 0.8; liftV += 0.15;
269:         switchState = { phase: 'in', t: 0, from: null, to: current };
270:       } else if (switchState.phase === 'in' && switchState.t >= SWITCH_IN) {
271:         switchState = null;
272:       }
273:     }
274: 
275:     const bob = Math.sin(player.bob * Math.PI * 2) * 0.008;
276:     for (const g of viewmodels) {
277:       if (!g.visible) continue;
278:       let sy = 0, sz = 0, srx = 0;
279:       if (switchState && switchState.phase === 'out' && g === viewmodels[switchState.from]) {
280:         const e = easeIn(Math.min(1, switchState.t / SWITCH_OUT));
281:         sy = -0.34 * e; sz = 0.3 * e; srx = 0.55 * e;
282:       } else if (switchState && switchState.phase === 'in' && g === viewmodels[switchState.to]) {
283:         const e = easeOut(Math.min(1, switchState.t / SWITCH_IN));
284:         sy = -0.34 * (1 - e); sz = 0.3 * (1 - e); srx = 0.55 * (1 - e);
285:       }
286:       g.position.z = BASE_Z + kick * 0.28 + sz;
287:       g.position.y = BASE_Y + lift * 0.05 + bob + sy;
288:       g.rotation.x = kick * 0.25 + lift * 0.12 + srx;
289:       if (NAMES[current] === 'chaingun') {
290:         g.rotation.z = Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.05) * 0.02;
291:       }
292:       // Peças animadas: slide da pistola, pump da escopeta, canos do chaingun.
293:       if (g.userData.slide) g.userData.slide.position.z = g.userData.slideZ + slideBack;
294:       if (g.userData.pump) g.userData.pump.position.z = g.userData.pumpZ + pumpBack;
295:       if (g.userData.barrels) {
296:         spinVel = firingT > 0
297:           ? Math.min(spinVel + 320 * dt, 46)
298:           : Math.max(0, spinVel - 140 * dt);
299:         g.userData.barrels.rotation.z += spinVel * dt;
300:       }
301:     }
302: 
303:     // Cápsulas: voam, giram e somem.
304:     for (let i = casings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
305:       const c = casings[i];
306:       c.velocity.y -= 4.2 * dt;
307:       c.position.addScaledVector(c.velocity, dt);
308:       c.rotation.x += c.angVel.x * dt;
309:       c.rotation.y += c.angVel.y * dt;
310:       c.rotation.z += c.angVel.z * dt;
311:       c.life -= dt;
312:       c.material.opacity = Math.max(0, c.life / 0.9);
313:       if (c.life <= 0) { viewGroup.remove(c); casings.splice(i, 1); }
314:     }
315:     // Fumaça: expande, sobe e some.
316:     for (let i = smokes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
317:       const s = smokes[i];
318:       s.position.addScaledVector(s.velocity, dt);
319:       s.velocity.multiplyScalar(Math.max(0, 1 - dt * 2.5));
320:       const k = s.life / 0.6;
321:       s.scale.setScalar(1 + (1 - k) * s.grow);
322:       s.material.opacity = 0.65 * Math.max(0, k);
323:       s.life -= dt;
324:       if (s.life <= 0) { viewGroup.remove(s); smokes.splice(i, 1); }
325:     }
326: 
327:     for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
328:       if (engine.wasPressed(KEYS[i])) select(i);
329:     }
330:     if (engine.input.scroll !== 0) {
331:       select((current + (engine.input.scroll > 0 ? 1 : 3)) % 4);
332:     }
333:     if (engine.input.keys.has('Mouse0')) fire();
334:   }
335: 
336:   return {
337:     get ammo() { return ammo; },
338:     get current() { return current; },
339:     get name() { return NAMES[current]; },
340:     update,
341:     fire,
342:     select,
343:     getViewmodel: () => viewmodels[current],
344:   };
345: }
346: 
347: export default createWeapons;
